title: Qworld: Question-Specific Evaluation Criteria for LLMs
reasoning: The paper introduces Qworld, an evaluation framework that benchmarks LLMs using generated taxonomies. These taxonomies include dimensions such as 'Privacy & Ethics', 'Equity & Accessibility', and 'Cultural Sensitivity'. Furthermore, the case study on medical advice for heat rash specifically identifies 'Religious Clothing Constraints' as a context-dependent scenario for evaluation.
